pattern.signal_summary: A source/generic proof did not model Windows PowerShell 5.1 native stderr semantics, producing a verification escape before provider contact.

interpretation: The failed assumption was evidence promotion across execution environments, not business-logic correctness. Exact shell/runtime family and material process-stream/exit semantics must be a distinct assurance rung when they can change fail-closed control flow.
expected_effect: Reduce recurrence of environment-specific verification escapes by requiring evidence at the execution rung that actually supports the accepted runtime claim.

success_metrics.target: 0 recurrence for exact-environment mechanism in bounded trial
success_metrics.notes: Primary quality signal; do not trade away verification.
Count the same root-cause mechanism, not unrelated failures.

notes: Native Candidate exists at skills/execution-conformance-ladder. Stable promotion requires normal Knowledge Promotion/release governance.
